$comment: The machine-readable archetype table of reference/story/personas.md (the contract). Read by the validator (scripts/story/lib/persona.mts: persona-cover) and mirrored by member.archetype in the schema and ARCHETYPES in assets/story/types.ts; a test keeps all three equal. `rooms` are room roles (schema roomRole); `anchorRoles` are role ids (roles.json). The app pools are a starting point: the catalog (catalog-apps.json) decides what may be named at all.

organiser.label: Organiser
organiser.description: Runs the household and often a small business from a home office: planning, files and paperwork.

builder.label: Builder
builder.description: Writes software for a living, laptop on the desk: the code and a local model both live on the Core.

gamer.label: Gamer
gamer.description: Plays on the Core from the couch or the bedroom: Steam Headless streams to a screen in the house.

learner.label: Learner
learner.description: Studies and reads: homework, languages and exams with local tools.

maker.label: Maker
maker.description: Paints, photographs, writes or plays; the household's creative work lives on the Core.

host.label: Host
host.description: Feeds, ferries, waters and tidies the house: the household's shared beats.

tech-family.label: Tech family
tech-family.description: The household lead of a family that already runs its own network, lamp rules and a few apps: the rest of the family is the acceptance test.

business-owner.label: Business owner
business-owner.description: Runs a shop, studio, agency or practice of one to fifteen people: quotes, invoices, contracts and the customer list.

creative.label: Creative
creative.description: A working designer, photographer, filmmaker, illustrator or musician: client work, an archive that outlives the job, and a brief that is confidential.

contractor.label: Contractor
contractor.description: A self-employed tradesperson or small building contractor: the quote, the site photos, the tools and the warranty cards, run from the garage bench.

marketer.label: Marketer
marketer.description: A freelance or in-house digital marketer: the client's list, files and briefs sit at home and the drafting model runs on the Core.

lawyer.label: Lawyer
lawyer.description: A solo or small-firm attorney: the client file, the engagement letter and a first-pass summary she checks line by line.

journalist.label: Journalist
journalist.description: A reporter, writer or researcher: the tape, the notes and the records sit on the Core and every quote is checked against the audio.

educator.label: Educator
educator.description: A teacher, tutor, lecturer or homeschooling parent: lesson folders, handouts and report comments the teacher rewrites by hand.

money-keeper.label: Money keeper
money-keeper.description: Owns the household ledger: bills, subscriptions, shared costs and the receipts behind them.

housemate.label: Housemate
housemate.description: Shares a rented flat on one Core: the bills, the chores, the shelf and the telly.

carer.label: Carer
carer.description: Keeps the post, the calendar and the notes for a parent, partner or relative they look after, with that person's say.

community-lead.label: Community lead
community-lead.description: Runs a club, choir, tenants' group or committee from the kitchen table: roll, minutes, rota and small budget.

researcher.label: Researcher
researcher.description: Reads, cites and writes up from sources: papers, archives and translated texts, with the reading, the notes and the drafts kept on the Core.

seller.label: Seller
seller.description: Sells what they make or find at a stall and by message, and keeps the stock, photos and invoices at home.

translator.label: Translator
translator.description: A freelance translator or subtitler: the draft, the notes and the client's PDFs sit on the Core, and every line is rewritten by hand.

archivist.label: Archivist
archivist.description: Scans and files the family's slides, letters and home films, and keeps them where the family's later readers can find them.

traveller.label: Traveller
traveller.description: Plans trips at the table and files the itinerary, the flight log and the photos once home.

athlete.label: Athlete
athlete.description: Trains most days, as a runner, a cyclist, a swimmer or a lifter: the runs, rides and sessions, the routes, the daily habits and the music sit on the Core.

collector.label: Collector
collector.description: Keeps a library of books, comics, records and films and knows where every one is: the files and the catalogue sit on the Core.

shift-worker.label: Shift worker
shift-worker.description: Works early, late or rotating shifts that do not match the household's day, and keeps one shared week across different clocks.
